notes.title: Demo Update v1.6 + Discord
notes.notes:
[b]Since I released the last update to the demo, I have made some general improvements to the gameplay and visuals.  This update reflects the new standard of quality that I maintain throughout the entire game.[/b]

[h3]Changes Include :[/h3]

[list]
[*]Hand Animations (Its ALIVVEEE!)
[*]Minor additions to level details
[*]Interaction and gameplay tweaks
[*]Replaced the forest in the first level with a cliffside to make it more obvious that you cant walk through it.
[*]Misc. bug fixes and other technical mumbo jumbo
[/list]

[i]BTW, I started a discord server if you want to know more about the project or give any feedback.  I will start posting there once we gather enough people :)[/i]

[url=https://discord.gg/yYhGzY2dZF style=button]Come Join the Discord![/url]

Peace and much love,

~Dez
